name: drenyra-engram
description: Scope-first institutional accounting memory core — observations, immutable revision history, lifecycle transitions, and the non-authorization boundary. Fiscal convention: monetary values in the Drenyra ecosystem are BigInt cents; no float is ever used for money; sequence/revision counters are JSON integers, never floats.

scripts.verify:package: node scripts/build.mjs && bun run test && node scripts/verify-package-files.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run verify:package && node scripts/verify-packed-install.mjs
